title: Local evaluation representative equation for an exact Hom source
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] globally and on each open, and fix $K,N\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and an open $U$. Let $P,F$ be arbitrary complexes of $\mathcal O_U$-modules, with $e_K:RK\cong QP$ and $e_N:RN\cong QF$, where $R$ is exact open restriction. Suppose the actual functor $\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,-)$ [def-pur-hom-complex] sends every quasi-isomorphism to a quasi-isomorphism, and its ordinary dual $D_P=\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,\mathcal O_U[0])$ is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Let $f:\operatorname{Tot}(F\otimes D_P)\to\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,F)$ be a chain map satisfying the ordinary evaluation component equations [def-pc-ordinary-evaluation-data]. Put $H=R\mathcal Hom$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], $D=H(K,\mathcal O_X[0])$, and let $g:N\otimes^L D\to H(K,N)$ be the adjunct, for the fixed canonical family [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection] and shared derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], of the associator followed by $1_N\otimes\mathrm{ev}$ and the right unitor, with $\mathrm{ev}$ the image of $1_D$ under that family. There exist isomorphisms $a:R(N\otimes^L D)\cong Q\operatorname{Tot}(F\otimes D_P)$ and $b:RH(K,N)\cong Q\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,F)$ such that $R(g);b=a;Q(f)$. No strict perfectness or bound on P or F, and no inverse of f or of R(g), is asserted.

proof.text: Apply lem-pc-canonical-evaluation-open-restriction to K,N. It supplies the commuting square from restricted global evaluation to canonical evaluation in the standard derived category of the open scheme, through the exact over-site derived equivalence E.

Apply lem-pc-exact-source-evaluation-open-models in that standard category to E(RK),E(RN), using the inverses of E(eK),E(eN), and the original hhom,hdual,f,hf. This gives the commuting square from canonical evaluation on the open scheme to E(Qf).

Compose the two source isomorphisms c and aU and the two target isomorphisms d and bU. The exact derived functor of the module equivalence is fully faithful (Functor.isEquivalence_mapDerivedCategory). Pull both composites back with Functor.preimageIso. Apply E.map_injective to the required equation, simplify map_preimage and map_comp, postcompose the restriction square by bU.hom, precompose the model square by c.hom, and combine them by equality transitivity after reassociation. This is the compiled Lean proof; all comparisons are existentially eliminated inside this proposition, with no definitions choosing unproved data. The private proved helper descend_comparison_squares carries out this elementary category-theoretic assembly independently of scheme instance inference.

theorem exists_exactSource_evaluation_local_comparisons (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (K N : schemeDerivedCategory X) (U : X.Opens)
    (P F : CochainComplex (localEvaluationModules X U) ℤ)
    (_hhom : ∀ (M M' : CochainComplex (localEvaluationModules X U) ℤ) (t : M ⟶ M'),
      QuasiIso t → QuasiIso (((homComplexFunctor (R := X.sheaf.over U)).obj (op P)).map t))
    (_hdual : (localEvaluationDual X U P).IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)
    (_eK : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
    (_eN : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj N ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj F)
    (f : localEvaluationTensor X U P F ⟶ homComplex (R := X.sheaf.over U) P F)
    (_hf : IsLocalOrdinaryEvaluation X U P F f) :
    let R := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory
    let H := derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace)
      X.toRingedSpace.sheaf
    let D := H.obj (op K, 𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X))
    let g := ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv X) (N ⊗ D) K N).symm
      ((α_ N D K).hom ≫ N ◁
        ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv X) D K (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X)) (𝟙 D)) ≫
          (ρ_ N).hom)
    ∃ a : R.obj (N ⊗ D) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (localEvaluationTensor X U P F),
      ∃ b : R.obj (H.obj (op K, N)) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj (homComplex (R := X.sheaf.over U) P F),
        R.map g ≫ b.hom = a.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f
